fields.title: SQL Mastery — Complete SQL Course
fields.short_description: Master Relational Databases, SQL Queries, Joins, Window Functions, CTEs, Transactions, and Database Optimization from Beginner to Advanced.
fields.description: The definitive SQL masterclass for ARSHITH BOOTCAMP. Learn database design, complex joins, data manipulation, aggregations, subqueries, window functions, CTEs, triggers, transactions, and interview preparation with 140 practical lessons, hands-on labs, interactive SQL playground, and verified certificate.
fields.requirements:
• No prior database experience required.
• Computer with a browser.
• Dedication to practice hands-on SQL queries.
fields.learning_objectives:
• Write production-grade SQL queries for MySQL, PostgreSQL & SQL Server.
• Master INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL, SELF & CROSS JOINs with visual clarity.
• Implement Window Functions (RANK, DENSE_RANK, ROW_NUMBER) & CTEs.
• Execute ACID Transactions & build scalable database schemas.
• Ace top enterprise SQL technical interview questions.

fields.title: Module 1: Data Science Foundations with Python
MODULE 1 — GETTING STARTED WITH SQL
fields.description: Focus on introducing SQL, relational database management systems, language parts, tools, comments, and SQL keywords.

fields.title: MODULE 2 — SQL ENVIRONMENT SETUP
fields.description: Step-by-step installation guides for Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL Workbench, and Linux Ubuntu environments.

fields.title: MODULE 3 — DATABASES AND TABLES
fields.description: Database and table creation concepts, data types, NULL attributes, and schema inspection.

fields.title: MODULE 4 — KEYS AND CONSTRAINTS
fields.description: Relational integrity, primary keys, foreign keys, table constraints, identity auto-increment, and index introduction.

fields.title: MODULE 5 — BASIC SQL COMMANDS
fields.description: Mastering core SQL DML and DDL commands for data selection, modification, and schema alteration.

fields.title: MODULE 6 — SQL PRACTICE
fields.description: Practical hands-on exercises combining all learned database and query concepts.

fields.title: MODULE 7 — FILTERING AND CONDITIONS
fields.description: Precision data extraction using WHERE, AND, OR, CASE, BETWEEN, date ranges, EXISTS, NOT EXISTS, and HAVING vs WHERE comparisons.

fields.title: MODULE 8 — SQL OPERATORS
fields.description: Set and membership operations: IN, NOT IN, comparison operators, LIKE pattern matching, wildcards, UNION, and UNION ALL.

fields.title: MODULE 9 — SQL JOINS
fields.description: Deep dive into combining tables: INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL OUTER, SELF, and CROSS JOINs with visual Venn diagrams and multi-table queries.

fields.title: MODULE 10 — GROUP BY, ORDER BY AND AGGREGATES
fields.description: Aggregating data across groups: GROUP BY, ORDER BY, ASC/DESC, LIMIT/OFFSET pagination, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, COUNT, and combined logic.

fields.title: MODULE 11 — STRING FUNCTIONS
fields.description: Manipulating textual data: CONCAT, SUBSTRING, REPLACE, TRIM, STRING_AGG / GROUP_CONCAT, and escaping special characters.

fields.title: MODULE 12 — DATE AND TIME FUNCTIONS
fields.description: Working with temporal data: DATE/DATETIME types, formatting, CURRENT_DATE/NOW/GETDATE, DATEADD arithmetic, DATEDIFF, and EXTRACT.

fields.title: MODULE 13 — NUMERIC AND NULL FUNCTIONS
fields.description: Mathematical operations: FLOOR, ROUND, CEILING, numeric expressions, handling NULLs, COALESCE, ISNULL, and NULL vs 0 vs empty string.

fields.title: MODULE 14 — WINDOW FUNCTIONS AND CTEs
fields.description: Advanced analytic SQL: OVER clause, RANK, DENSE_RANK, ROW_NUMBER, PARTITION BY, running totals, top N per group, WITH clause CTEs.

fields.title: MODULE 15 — STORED PROCEDURES AND TRIGGERS
fields.description: Database automation: Stored procedures, parameters, execution, BEFORE/AFTER triggers, and cross-database procedural syntax.

fields.title: MODULE 16 — TRANSACTIONS AND ADVANCED OPTIMIZATION
fields.description: ACID transactions, COMMIT, ROLLBACK, SAVEPOINT, database relationships, normalization (1NF-3NF), subqueries, EXISTS vs IN, query optimization.
